title: Some Silicon Valley city programs are missing
text: Los Altos city teen programs and Cupertino Leaders in Training are not listed yet. Those pages did not give ages or dates when last checked.

title: Some East Bay city programs are missing
text: Pleasanton library teen volunteers are not listed yet. San Leandro, Union City and Fremont are listed, but the San Leandro and Fremont commission pages do not say how to apply.

title: Hospital teen volunteering is only partly covered
text: Kaiser lists high school volunteering at Walnut Creek, Santa Clara, San Jose, Redwood City and South San Francisco, but several are full or closed right now. Alta Bates Summit and the Alameda Health System volunteer program are 18 and up, and Sutter Davis does not take students.

title: Davis and West Sacramento summer jobs are not open yet
text: City lifeguard and camp jobs for teens 15 and up usually open in late January and February. The cards show last summer's dates and pay until the 2027 postings go up. Davis Junior Basketball is hiring teens now.

title: A few cards say Confirm first
text: These cards were not read on the program's own page, usually because the site blocked us. Check the details on the official site before you rely on them.

title: Boys and Girls Clubs are only partly covered
text: Oakland, San Leandro, San Francisco and Peninsula clubs have teen cards. Other clubs, including Sacramento and Silicon Valley, did not post teen details we could use.

title: Some Southern California city pages could not be read
text: Costa Mesa's youth pages do not state job ages, and several LA museum and hospital pages could not be checked.

title: Some Atlanta pages could not be read
text: The City of Atlanta's own Summer Youth Employment pages and the airport's youth workforce programs could not be checked, so pay and signup details come from other official pages.

title: Some New York Parks, NYPL and museum programs are missing
text: NYC Parks teen programs other than lifeguards are missing. The New York Public Library and the AMNH, Met and MoMA teen pages could not be checked, so those programs are not listed yet.

title: Some Chicago and Elgin pages could not be read
text: The Cook County Forest Preserves Conservation Corps, Elgin's School District U-46 career pages and the Hoffman Estates parks pages could not be checked.

title: Pacific Northwest and Vancouver
text: Some Seattle and Vancouver library, Park Board, hospital and museum pages could not be checked, so those programs are not listed yet.

title: Texas and Twin Cities
text: Children's Minnesota, Hennepin Healthcare, the Minneapolis Institute of Art and Austin's workforce youth program could not be checked, so those programs are not listed yet.

title: Midwest campuses
text: Madison and Parks jobs, Indiana hospital and city pages, Ohio state pages and University of Michigan programs could not be checked. Ohio's 2026 minimum wage is not on the site yet.

title: East Coast
text: Durham and Raleigh youth jobs, several Maryland and Philadelphia hospitals and libraries, and the Massachusetts state pages could not be checked.

title: Santa Barbara, Merced, San Diego and Inland Empire
text: City of Merced and UC Merced, Cottage Health, Riverside County workforce and the City of Pomona could not be checked, so those programs are not listed yet.
